method: Read-only parse of the actual original teacher lesson HTML on Our-CS, with raw SHA256 captured per teacher lesson page; original preparation/student source checksums matched separately to canonical manifest. Map candidate Practice family identifiers in first-party C# implementation; activity headings are short source-identifying excerpts.
limitations: Source activity headings, Student Facing section counts and family identifiers are evidence of scope/traceability ONLY. They do not prove the individual student task mathematics, visual fidelity, teacher-led activities, exact effective lesson body, live browser experience, correct grading, rights or Edulytics internal academic acceptance. There is no claim that each source activity requires its own digital family.
sourceAttribution: Illustrative Mathematics K–5 Math (First Edition, 2021), CC BY 4.0; short activity headings reproduced for source-reference traceability, not publisher figures.
